title: MIFF 2026: In Pictures - Red Carpet Arrivals at the 19th MIFF Closing Ceremony 2026
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

MIFF 2026: In Pictures - Red Carpet Arrivals at the 19th MIFF Closing Ceremony 2026

Mumbai, 21 June 2026



The red carpet of the Closing Ceremony of the 19th Mumbai International Film Festival (MIFF) 2026 was graced by several dignitaries and renowned personalities from the film industry.

The event was attended by Hon'ble Governor of Maharashtra Shri Jishnu Dev Varma, Secretary, Marathi Language and Cultural Affairs, Government of Maharashtra, Shri Kiran Kulkarni, and Managing Director, NFDC Prakash Magdum. The event also saw the presence of acclaimed filmmaker Ashutosh Gowariker, actress Aimee Baruah, actress Sheena Chohan,
Dr. Kiran Shantaram
and renowned animator-director Raimund Krumme.

Relive the glamour, smiles, and memorable moments that marked the grand finale of a week long celebration of cinema at MIFF 2026.

Hon'ble Governor of Maharashtra Shri Jishnu Dev Varma , Secretary, Marathi Language and Cultural Affairs, Government of Maharashtra, Shri Kiran Kulkarni and Managing Director, NFDC Prakash Magdum, on the red carpet ahead of the Closing Ceremony of the 19th Mumbai International Film Festival (MIFF).



Filmmaker Ashutosh Gowariker and Managing Director, NFDC, Prakash Magdum, on the red carpet ahead of the Closing Ceremony of the 19th MIFF.





Actress Aimee Baruah arrives at the red carpet of the Closing Ceremony of the 19th MIFF.



Dr. Kiran Shantaram, son of legendary filmmaker V. Shantaram, and Ujwal Nirgudkar, Technical Advisor to India’s National Film Heritage Mission, on the red carpet at the MIFF 2026 Closing Ceremony.



Dr. Vishwas Deoskar CEO Indian Institute of Creative Technology  (IICT) gracing the red carpet event of MIFF closing ceremony



Actress Sheena Chohan
graces the red carpet at the Closing Ceremony of MIFF 2026



Director & Animator, Raimund Krumme graces the red carpet at the MIFF 2026 Closing Ceremony.
